Tree Services in the Blue Mountains — Removal, Lopping & Pruning

Tree removal, lopping, pruning and trimming across the Blue Mountains — done safely by careful, insured operators.

The Mountains are full of big trees, and near homes they need managing — for safety, for light, and before storm and fire season. We remove, reduce and prune trees cleanly and safely.

We clean up fully and can chip and mulch on site. For protected trees we can advise on what's allowed.

What’s included

  • Tree removal, large and small
  • Lopping and crown reduction
  • Pruning and shaping
  • Storm and hazard clean-up
  • Stump grinding
  • Full clean-up and mulching

Why Blue Mountains Landscapers

We build for Mountains conditions every day — slope, sandstone, cold and bushfire zones. You get one accountable local crew, a clear fixed quote, and work built to last. Right now every job comes with 20% off for spring and summer.
